description: CNAME for one subdomain label to cname.dub.co. Optional Vercel ownership TXT at _vercel on the zone apex.
variableDescription: Do not pass the Domain Connect host parameter. cnameHost is the subdomain label only (go for go.example.com). verification group: txtValue is the Vercel TXT value (vc-domain-verify=...). The TXT name is fixed at _vercel so it is not written under the subdomain. multiInstance so a later subdomain does not remove an earlier one. txtConflictMatchingMode None so another _vercel TXT value is added beside existing ones.
